scope.description: Sentinel AMS named-company dossier focused on Canadian identity, deployable defence infrastructure, edge manufacturing, modular systems, power, UAS and counter-UAS offerings, parentage, and current industry activity.

leads.evidenceLocator: Official Sentinel capability portfolio, CMP Canadian location and manufacturing pages, and CADSI CANSEC exhibitor pages
followUpQuestions: Confirm whether Sentinel Advanced Military Solutions is a distinct incorporated legal entity or an operating brand within CMP Advanced Mechanical Solutions.
Resolve StarForge DTIN, ForgeX, ForgeExtreme, LARS, and other CANSEC product names to durable company or government pages before adding those more-specific records.
Confirm public deployment, contract, specification, and maturity details as Sentinel publishes durable technical or program evidence.
reviewWarnings: Sentinel's official policies identify CMP as the site operator, but no separate Sentinel legal name was found; legalName remains null.
Specific CANSEC names such as StarForge DTIN, ForgeX, ForgeExtreme, and LARS surfaced through LinkedIn discovery and are not promoted as field evidence without durable corroboration.
The official portfolio does not yet publish customer deployments, contracts, detailed specifications, or readiness levels for the proposed capability families.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: The official company profile and policies resolve the Sentinel operating role, CMP relationship, Quebec jurisdiction, public contact channel, and Canadian corporate context.
The official capability portfolio resolves five concrete system families and their bounded features and intended operational applications.
The official CADSI event directory corroborates Sentinel's current Canadian defence-sector activity and 2026 CANSEC exhibitor status.

leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Sentinel describes itself as a defence-focused systems integration company within the CMP Group of Companies. Its official portfolio identifies the Star Forge deployable ecosystem, point-of-need manufacturing through secure digital stockpiles, modular command and support enclosures, hybrid power systems, and layered UAS and counter-UAS integration. CMP's official site establishes the shared Châteauguay manufacturing campus and its defence-infrastructure production capability. CADSI's CANSEC 2026 media kit independently lists Sentinel as a new exhibitor and explains that exhibitors are Canadian-registered private-sector member companies with active Canadian operations.
